# Bude Canoe Club

> Volunteer-run Community Amateur Sports Club (CASC) in Bude, Cornwall, founded in 2003. Kayaking, canoeing, canoe polo, surf kayaking and white water paddling for ages 5 and up, serving North Cornwall and West Devon. Paddle UK affiliated, Paddle UK qualified coaches, DBS-checked volunteers, insured, all kit and boats provided. First session free.

## Key facts
- Winter pool sessions: every Wednesday 7pm–9pm, October to March, Holsworthy Leisure Centre swimming pool, Victoria Hill, Holsworthy EX22 6LB. 7–8pm General Skills (all abilities, beginners welcome), 8–9pm Canoe Polo.
- Summer sea & canal sessions: every Wednesday 6pm–8pm, April to September. Meet at Summerleaze Beach Car Park, Bude EX23 8HN, by the club kayak trailer near the Lifeboat Station.
- Summer canoe polo: fortnightly Mondays 6:30pm–8pm, Bude Canal, Breakwater Road.
- Prices: first session free; pay as you go £12 per session; All Inclusive Membership £25/month adults, £15/month juniors (18 and under) and concessions (60 and over).
- Ages: 5 and up, no upper limit. Under 16s: message the club first about swimming/paddling ability.
- Booking: sign up at https://spond.com/landing/group/FNILN and message the club.
- Coaches include British and World Surf Kayaking Champions. Canoe polo team: Bude Smugglers. Hosts the Andy Hambley Trophy canoe polo tournament every August Bank Holiday Monday (next: 30 August 2027).
- Areas served: Bude, Holsworthy, Stratton, Widemouth Bay, Kilkhampton, Morwenstow, Marhamchurch, Bridgerule, Bradworthy, Hartland, Boscastle, Camelford, Launceston, Week St Mary, Shebbear, Hatherleigh, Okehampton, Bideford, Great Torrington.
- Contact: budecanoeclub@gmail.com · Instagram @bude_canoe_club · https://www.facebook.com/budecanoeclub
